production_state.note: This example reflects Leeds A100 Home interview guidance for the supported scope.

applicant_context.applicant_summary: Home standard A-level school-leaver meeting Leeds GCSE and AAA Biology/Chemistry requirements, UCAT 2050/2700 and SJT Band 2.

engine_assumptions: Home standard A-level school-leaver guidance uses the approved ApplySmart internal compensation matrix.
Achieved and predicted grades are treated identically until Leeds publishes a weighting distinction.
WP and International pools are not mapped to Home thresholds.
SJT Band 4 is an eligibility exclusion; SJT Bands 1-3 receive no points.
readiness.architecture_change_summary: Generic opt-in academic-UCAT compensation-matrix component and public score-breakdown suppression were added for internal-only methodology profiles.
do_not_infer: Do not present ApplySmart's internal calculation details as official Leeds policy.
Do not apply an achieved-grade uplift.
Do not reuse Home UCAT bands for WP or International applicants.
Do not invent graduate, IB, Scottish or alternative-route scoring.
manual_review_boundaries: IB, Scottish and alternative qualification routes.

eligibility.summary: The represented Home standard school-leaver meets Leeds published GCSE, A-level, UCAT, SJT and science practical endorsement requirements.
